tags: Scores higher for pubkeys that publish more video events (kinds 21, 22, 34235, 34236).
content:
plan
  videos = do 'nostr.query' {kinds: [21, 22, 34235, 34236], authors: [_.targetPubkey], limit: 50}
in
let
  events = videos | [],
  n = length(events)
in
if n > 20 then 1.0
else if n > 10 then 0.8
else if n > 5 then 0.6
else if n > 2 then 0.4
else if n > 0 then 0.2
else 0.0
